workflow_text: The assistant recommends automatically renewing Acme Analytics for 12 months. It states that Acme meets all security requirements, has no unresolved incidents, remains within budget, and uses standard terms. Procurement should issue the purchase order without further review.

controlled_evidence_set.title: Vendor renewal ticket
controlled_evidence_set.excerpt_or_summary: A 12-month renewal was requested. Pricing appears similar to last year, but the final quote is not attached.
controlled_evidence_set.known_limitations: No security review, legal review, final quote, or complete incident history is attached.

controlled_evidence_set.title: Information security review policy
controlled_evidence_set.excerpt_or_summary: Vendors processing customer data require annual security review before renewal. Exceptions require written Security Governance approval.

controlled_evidence_set.title: Incident export
controlled_evidence_set.excerpt_or_summary: No Sev-1 incidents were linked to Acme Analytics in the last 12 months.
controlled_evidence_set.known_limitations: The export excludes lower severities, privacy issues, and open vendor issues.

review_context.decision_to_support: Whether the recommendation is evidence-ready for approval
known_constraints: Use only the controlled evidence set.
Do not query external vendor systems.
